questions.context_sentence: These people are standing in a queue to get into the cinema.
questions.cn: 这些人正在排队进入电影院。
questions.hint: 排队的人像字母q-u-e-u-e一样排成一长串。
questions.prompt: These people are standing in a ____ to get into the cinema. (提示: 行列，长队)

questions.context_sentence: The auditorium is packed with seated people watching a movie screen.
questions.cn: 礼堂里挤满了坐着看电影屏幕的人。
questions.hint: audio（声音）+ torium（场所）= 听音乐或看电影的礼堂。

questions.context_sentence: The government will be making a statement about the crisis later today.
questions.cn: 政府将于今天晚些时候就这场危机发表声明。
questions.hint: 快（cri）死（sis）了，说明遇到了大危机。

questions.context_sentence: Later in the programme, I'll be talking to the Minister of Education.
questions.cn: 在接下来的节目中，我将与教育部长交谈。
questions.hint: mini（小）+ ster（人），虽然叫小人，但其实是国家的大臣。
questions.prompt: Later in the programme, I'll be talking to the ____ of Education. (提示: 大臣，部长)

questions.context_sentence: The team's star player is injured and won't be playing in the game on Saturday.
questions.cn: 该队的明星球员受伤了，将不会参加周六的比赛。
questions.hint: in（在里面）+ jury（伤害），身体内部受伤了。

questions.context_sentence: Every day he follows the same routine and tomorrow will be no exception.
questions.cn: 他每天都遵循相同的常规，明天也不会例外。
questions.hint: 肉（rou）听（tine）你的常规安排。

questions.context_sentence: Tomorrow will be no exception.
questions.cn: 明天也不会例外。
questions.hint: ex（出）+ cept（拿）+ ion，拿出去不一样的就是例外。
questions.prompt: Tomorrow will be no ____. (提示: 例外)

questions.context_sentence: There's an election next week.
questions.cn: 下周有一场选举。
questions.hint: e + lec（选择）+ tion，大家一起投票选择。

questions.context_sentence: Please fasten your seat belts.
questions.cn: 请系好您的安全带。
questions.hint: fast（快/固定）+ en（使…），使固定系牢。

questions.context_sentence: I will be doing something is the future continuous tense.
questions.cn: 我将要做某事是将来进行时。
questions.hint: future（将来）+ continuous（进行）= 将来进行时。
questions.prompt: I will be doing something is the ____ tense. (提示: 将来进行时)
